policy: exact paths only; no wildcards, no localhost and no cross-project redirect
additional_checks: Email templates must honor RedirectTo when customized rather than hardcode SiteURL.
Any callback route added in stage 6 requires matching exact allowlist URL and separate review.
Do not enable wildcard redirect URLs for the production project.
Staging on the same host must use separate Supabase project ID and controlled isolated browser testing.
backup_gate: No Supabase Auth settings mutation until independently verified encrypted backup and isolated restore.
